title: OpenAI / AI Model → DNA OS MCP Requester Connection
scope: The implemented model/requester boundary into DNA OS through the existing MCP host. This record does not claim a direct OpenAI API connector, provider router, or model registry implementation that is absent from this repository.

security.rule: Secret values are never recorded. Only reference names and resolution mechanisms are recorded.

references.name: OWNER_COMMAND_HTTP_SHARED_SECRET
references.used_by: DnaOsHttpClient Authorization header and Core requireSharedSecret
references.resolution: process environment supplied to the trusted local process; value is never documented

references.name: DNA_OS_OWNER_SESSION_ID
references.used_by: stdio MCP owner-session pointer when no explicit caller context is bound
references.resolution: process environment; Core validates the pointer with validateOwnerSession

references.name: x-dna-os-owner-session
references.used_by: HTTP MCP caller context and Core Owner-session binding
references.resolution: request header containing a session-store pointer; the header value is not authority by itself

references.name: credential://anthropic/owner/agent-runtime
references.used_by: credential registry metadata for an Anthropic agent-runtime provider reference
references.resolution: macOS Keychain resolver metadata; no secret value is copied here
references.status: REGISTERED_REFERENCE_ONLY; no provider adapter in this repository consumes it

role_separation.model: requester/reasoner only: proposes text or a structured interpretation; it cannot authenticate the Owner, select authority, create IDs, authorize execution, or write registries
role_separation.dna_os: authority/executor: authenticates the human Owner, resolves identity, applies policy, routes registered capabilities, executes workers, records task/result/evidence, and returns the authoritative result

boundaries.contract_function: createDnaOsMcpServer; MCP tool registration and invocation
boundaries.transport_or_signal: MCP JSON-RPC over Streamable HTTP POST /mcp, or MCP stdio
boundaries.authentication: HTTP caller context comes from x-dna-os-owner-session or the internal credential; stdio requires an explicit valid Owner session pointer for Owner tools
boundaries.authority_permission: The model is a requester. MCP export policy permits discovery/invocation only for the caller context; the model cannot supply authority in tool arguments.
boundaries.input_schema: MCP tool call; submit_command requires commandText:string and has optional correlation-only agentIdentity
boundaries.output_result: MCP CallToolResult with correlation_id and the real DNA OS status/result/evidence projection
boundaries.state_transition: External model request is accepted, denied by export policy, or passed to the registered tool handler
failure_modes: stdio without a valid Owner session
boundaries.verification_note: The generic MCP host and its live Core round trip are evidenced. No OpenAI-specific client/API invocation is live-verified in this repository.

boundaries.transport_or_signal: Typed function call; correlation_id generated by the MCP handler
boundaries.endpoint: None; next boundary is Core HTTP
boundaries.authentication: Owner session is bound from transport caller context; the handler does not mint or trust a model-supplied session
boundaries.authority_permission: MCP export/invoke gate runs before the handler; agentIdentity is correlation-only
boundaries.output_result: DnaOsHttpResponse {status, body}; response is projected without inventing an outcome
boundaries.state_transition: MCP tool invocation becomes a request to the existing Core owner-command ingress

boundaries.destination: DNA OS Core HTTP owner-command transport
boundaries.transport_or_signal: HTTP POST JSON with Content-Type application/json
boundaries.authentication: Authorization Bearer from OWNER_COMMAND_HTTP_SHARED_SECRET when configured, plus x-dna-os-owner-session when bound
boundaries.authority_permission: The shared secret authenticates the trusted transport client only; it is explicitly not Owner authentication
boundaries.input_schema: {commandText:string, ownerIdentity?:{id:string,email:string}}; MCP sends commandText and does not use ownerIdentity as authority
boundaries.output_result: Real Core HTTP status and parsed JSON body
boundaries.state_transition: The model-originated tool request enters the existing Core Owner command ingress

boundaries.transport_or_signal: x-dna-os-owner-session header, or validated stdio session pointer
boundaries.authentication: Session must exist, be active, unexpired, and have authenticated_via beginning with human-verification
boundaries.authority_permission: Only a human-verified Owner session can bind Owner authority; a model cannot self-assert it
boundaries.state_transition: Invalid/unauthenticated requests stop before Owner command submission; valid requests bind the authenticated Owner

boundaries.transport_or_signal: Authenticated owner id from the validated session
boundaries.authentication: Inherited from b04; body identity cannot replace it
boundaries.authority_permission: Maps the authenticated human to the fixed DNA OS account/workspace scope and execution grant
boundaries.output_result: EnvelopeIdentity with kind=human and fixed account/workspace scope
boundaries.state_transition: Validated human session becomes the Owner command principal

boundaries.transport_or_signal: In-process call after JSON/body and authentication checks
boundaries.authentication: Authenticated human Owner identity from b05
boundaries.authority_permission: submitOwnerCommand accepts only a human identity
boundaries.output_result: SubmitOwnerCommandOutcome containing command envelope, work_id, lifecycle, result, surface, and output routing
boundaries.state_transition: command_received → classify/route → admitted or terminal result

boundaries.transport_or_signal: CommandEnvelope with command_id, issued_by, intent, payload, issued_at
boundaries.authentication: Owner identity remains attached to the envelope
boundaries.authority_permission: Router may select only registered capabilities; execution.run additionally needs executionRequestBase and execution policy context
boundaries.output_result: CapabilityResult with task_id, capability_id, status, summary, evidence, artifacts, warnings, next_action
boundaries.state_transition: command envelope classified → task created → capability result admitted or terminalized
failure_modes: execution policy context missing for execution.run

boundaries.authority_permission: The registry is authoritative for supported capability IDs, endpoint contracts, permission requirements, and health status
boundaries.input_schema: Command text and structured Owner context
boundaries.state_transition: Raw request becomes a registered capability selection; no match or ambiguity stops/block routes

boundaries.endpoint: In-process contract; worker launch is controlled by Agent Host
boundaries.authentication: Owner command/task lineage and Agent Host confinement
boundaries.authority_permission: Registered capability and Agent Host policy authorize dispatch; model does not choose an arbitrary implementation
boundaries.input_schema: WorkOrder with agent_run, workspace/source paths, task identity, and expected result contract
boundaries.output_result: Agent result with work_order_id, workspace_id, launch_id, result_id, verification_id, status, evidence_refs
boundaries.state_transition: task admitted → agent-host dispatch → worker lifecycle

boundaries.transport_or_signal: DNA_OS_AGENT_INPUT_V1 to a controlled worker process
boundaries.endpoint: Local worker process; no external network endpoint
boundaries.authentication: Agent Host launch boundary and environment allowlist
boundaries.authority_permission: Worker kind=LOCAL; allowed operations and paths come from the WorkOrder/WorkspaceManager, not the model
boundaries.input_schema: DNA_OS_AGENT_INPUT_V1 with work_order_id, workspace_id, objective, source_refs, allowed_operations, allowed_write_paths, expected_result_contract=DNA_OS_AGENT_RESULT_V1
boundaries.output_result: Launch record with launch_id, exit code, stdout/stderr, timing, and worker status

boundaries.transport_or_signal: Workspace lifecycle events and assigned write path
boundaries.endpoint: Local filesystem worktree resolved from the reservation
boundaries.authority_permission: Allowed read/write scope is assigned before worker execution; worker cannot choose the source path
boundaries.output_result: Workspace state and isolated worktree path
boundaries.state_transition: CREATE → PREPARE_CONTEXT → ASSIGN_AGENT(LOCAL) → RUNNING → RESULT_RECEIVED → VERIFYING → ACCEPTED → CLOSED

boundaries.transport_or_signal: DNA_OS_AGENT_RESULT_V1 plus task/workspace lifecycle and evidence events
boundaries.endpoint: Local append-only task/evidence stores and joint monitor
boundaries.authentication: Result is correlated to task_id/work_order_id/launch_id; verification is required before acceptance
boundaries.authority_permission: Only verified result status can transition the task/workspace to ACCEPTED/COMPLETED
boundaries.input_schema: Worker result contract plus evidence references
boundaries.output_result: Persisted result, evidence_refs, task status, and completion decision
failure_modes: task not in accepting lifecycle state

boundaries.endpoint: Response to the originating MCP request
boundaries.authentication: Same request context; no new authority is created by the response
boundaries.authority_permission: DNA OS result and evidence remain authoritative; the model can observe them but cannot alter them through the response
boundaries.input_schema: Core response body containing command/work/task/result/evidence fields
boundaries.output_result: status, correlation_id, dna_os_command_id, dna_os_work_id, dna_os_task_id, dna_os_decision_id, dna_os_result_status, output_lane, evidence, error, reason_code, raw body
boundaries.state_transition: Completed/failed/blocked DNA OS state is returned to the requester without being upgraded by MCP
failure_modes: Core error is returned as error/reason_code

boundaries.contract_function: No implemented OpenAI adapter, model router, or provider API caller found
boundaries.authentication: No OpenAI credential reference or resolver is implemented here
boundaries.authority_permission: Not applicable; no provider connector is wired
failure_modes: provider API cannot be invoked through a DNA OS connector because none is wired
provider credential may be registered as metadata but is not consumed by an adapter

boundaries.destination: DNA OS deterministic resolver and Owner command authority
boundaries.transport_or_signal: Local model text/JSON output into a typed validation contract
boundaries.authentication: The model output carries no Owner authority
boundaries.authority_permission: The model may extract language only; resolver/registry/evidence prove references and DNA OS retains permission/lifecycle/execution authority
boundaries.input_schema: Raw model JSON with only named text/interpretation fields; id-shaped values are rejected
boundaries.output_result: AiValidation: accepted interpretation or explicit rejection reasons
boundaries.state_transition: Untrusted model output → validated interpretation or rejected/ unresolved semantic input
failure_modes: local model unavailable; owner command path proceeds without the translation aid
boundaries.verification_note: The source and tests establish the separation contract; this is not evidence of an OpenAI API provider connection.

execution_run_boundary.statement: execution.run from the live Owner command ingress is currently NOT_WIRED / NOT_VERIFIED because executionRequestBase is not supplied.
execution_run_boundary.failure_mode: Router stops/fails closed when required execution context is absent; no success is inferred.

live_verification.voice_bridge_reference: Previously verified voice-bridge COMPLETED path is a separate in-process bridge; it distinguishes direct in-process execution from this external-model MCP requester path.

overall_gaps: No OpenAI provider API client/adapter is implemented in this repository.
ai/model-router, ai/model-registry, and connections/ai-providers are README-only/not yet built.
The registered Anthropic credential reference is metadata only for this connection; no provider adapter consumes it here.
The live evidence proves the MCP → DNA OS path, not a provider-specific OpenAI API call.
next_required_connection: If a direct provider connection is later requested, create a separate evidence-backed provider document only after an actual adapter, credential resolver, caller, and live verification exist. Do not upgrade this record's provider boundary from NOT_WIRED.
